title: MorphEvent
description: A record of an applied persona change. This format does not implement logging, authenticate approval, establish client loading, or execute rollback; the integration links it to actual evidence.

author.description: Executor of the recorded change, not the source of authorization. An agent may apply a specifically authorized change within scope.

type.description: Declared change category. Any semantic effect on the agreed Anchor requires substantive human conversation and specific approval, even when another category is selected.

field.description: Dot-path to the changed field, e.g. behavior.on_offtopic.

old_value.description: Previous value as a string, or null. Structured values require an agreed representation; this schema does not define a patch format.

new_value.description: Applied value as a string. A record alone does not prove the change was loaded or produced the intended behavior.

rollback_safe.description: A claim requiring verification of actual rollback consequences. The schema default is an annotation, not evidence of safety or permission to roll back.
